plan.title: Send Bulk Counter Offers to All Vendors

steps.note: Open a suitable existing published RFQ with several vendor quotes.
Assert that the RFQ Settings menu offers the bulk counter-offer action and that it is enabled.
Open the bulk counter-offer drawer from the RFQ Settings menu.

args.goal: decide the counter offer for all vendors, send it, and stop when the buyer screen shows the send succeeded

steps.note: Complete the bulk counter-offer form and submit it on the buyer screen.
Assert that Procol reported a successful bulk counter-offer submission.
